name: PassCamp
description_en:
PassCamp is a product in the Password management category. Its directory profile covers Password Reset, Password Generator, Secure Password Sharing, Multifactor Authentication, Offline Functionality, Backup/Restore, Third-party Integration, Password Encryption.

Additional listed capabilities include Saved Cards, Mobiles Password Management, Websites Password Management. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: create passwords using configured requirements. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出保存支付卡信息、移动设备密码管理、网站密码管理。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS) 桌面应用 (Windows, Mac)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 个人用户。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。
